contenu_original:
Chott el Jerid is one of the most remarkable landscapes in southern Tunisia.

For much of the year, this vast salt lake is almost completely dry. What remains is an immense white salt crust stretching toward the horizon, where heat and light often create mirages that make water seem to appear in the distance.

The road across Chott el Jerid is part of the journey between Tunisia’s oasis towns and the Sahara, and sunrise is one of the best times to see how dramatically the landscape changes with the light.

It is one of those places that photographs never quite explain until you stand there yourself.

See Chott el Jerid as part of your private Sahara journey with Jasmin Adventures.

Recently, we welcomed a Miriam and her partner who had a very special dream:
to return to Tunisia for the first time since she left as a very young child.

In her own words:
“𝑰𝒕 𝒉𝒂𝒅 𝒃𝒆𝒆𝒏 𝒂 𝒍𝒊𝒇𝒆𝒍𝒐𝒏𝒈 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒎𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒓𝒆𝒕𝒖𝒓𝒏 𝒕𝒐 𝑻𝒖𝒏𝒊𝒔𝒊𝒂… 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒐𝒏𝒍𝒚 𝒎𝒆𝒎𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒆𝒔 𝑰 𝒉𝒂𝒅 𝒘𝒆𝒓𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒐𝒔𝒆 𝒑𝒂𝒔𝒔𝒆𝒅 𝒅𝒐𝒘𝒏 𝒃𝒚 𝒎𝒚 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒔 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒔𝒊𝒃𝒍𝒊𝒏𝒈𝒔.”

From the moment they arrived, she said,
“𝒘𝒆 𝒌𝒏𝒆𝒘 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒘𝒐𝒖𝒍𝒅 𝒃𝒆 𝒂 𝒔𝒑𝒆𝒄𝒊𝒂𝒍 𝒋𝒐𝒖𝒓𝒏𝒆𝒚.”

Our guide, Khalil, and our driver, Mohamed, accompanied them through breathtaking places like Dougga, El Jem, and the Sahara.
But one day stood out above all:

💛 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝒅𝒂𝒚 𝒘𝒆 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒉𝒐𝒖𝒔𝒆 𝒘𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒆 𝒔𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒂𝒔 𝒃𝒐𝒓𝒏 𝒎𝒐𝒓𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒏 60 𝒚𝒆𝒂𝒓𝒔 𝒂𝒈𝒐.

She wrote:
“𝑲𝒉𝒂𝒍𝒊𝒍 𝒘𝒆𝒏𝒕 𝒂𝒃𝒐𝒗𝒆 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒃𝒆𝒚𝒐𝒏𝒅… 𝒉𝒆 𝒂𝒔𝒌𝒆𝒅 𝒍𝒐𝒄𝒂𝒍𝒔, 𝒗𝒊𝒔𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒕𝒐𝒘𝒏 𝒉𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒕𝒐 𝒄𝒉𝒆𝒄𝒌 𝒓𝒆𝒄𝒐𝒓𝒅𝒔, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒆𝒙𝒑𝒍𝒐𝒓𝒆𝒅 𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓𝒚 𝒑𝒐𝒔𝒔𝒊𝒃𝒍𝒆 𝒍𝒆𝒂𝒅.”

Thanks to the incredible kindness of the people they met along the way, and the guide’s dedication, they found the house, the café her parents once ran, and even the school her family attended generations ago.

She described it as:
“𝑻𝒓𝒖𝒍𝒚 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒆 𝒕𝒓𝒖𝒆… 𝒂 𝒓𝒆𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒄𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏 𝒘𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝒎𝒚 𝒑𝒂𝒔𝒕 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝑰’𝒍𝒍 𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓 𝒃𝒆 𝒈𝒓𝒂𝒕𝒆𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒇𝒐𝒓.”

Stories like this remind us why we do what we do.
✨ 𝑻𝒖𝒏𝒊𝒔𝒊𝒂 𝒊𝒔𝒏’𝒕 𝒋𝒖𝒔𝒕 𝒂 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒊𝒏𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏 𝒊𝒕’𝒔 𝒂 𝒑𝒍𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒐𝒇 𝒓𝒐𝒐𝒕𝒔, 𝒎𝒆𝒎𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒆𝒔, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒓𝒆𝒅𝒊𝒔𝒄𝒐𝒗𝒆𝒓𝒚.
And we’re honored to be part of moments that stay in people’s hearts forever.

🇹🇳 Tunisia is waiting to welcome you, too.
Whether it's a homecoming or your first adventure here, we’d love to craft a meaningful journey for you.

“𝑲𝒉𝒂𝒍𝒊𝒍 𝒘𝒆𝒏𝒕 𝒂𝒃𝒐𝒗𝒆 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒃𝒆𝒚𝒐𝒏𝒅… 𝒉𝒆 𝒂𝒔𝒌𝒆𝒅 𝒍𝒐𝒄𝒂𝒍𝒔, 𝒗𝒊𝒔𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒕𝒐𝒘𝒏 𝒉𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒕𝒐 𝒄𝒉𝒆𝒄𝒌 𝒓𝒆𝒄𝒐𝒓𝒅𝒔, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒆𝒙𝒑𝒍𝒐𝒓𝒆𝒅 𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓𝒚 𝒑𝒐𝒔𝒔𝒊𝒃𝒍𝒆 𝒍𝒆𝒂𝒅.”

Thanks to the incredible kindness of the people they met along the way, and the guide’s dedication, they found the house, the café her parents once ran, and even the school her family attended generations ago.

She described it as:
“𝑻𝒓𝒖𝒍𝒚 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒆 𝒕𝒓𝒖𝒆… 𝒂 𝒓𝒆𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒄𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏 𝒘𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝒎𝒚 𝒑𝒂𝒔𝒕 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝑰’𝒍𝒍 𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓 𝒃𝒆 𝒈𝒓𝒂𝒕𝒆𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒇𝒐𝒓.”

Stories like this remind us why we do what we do.

Chott el Jerid is one of the most remarkable landscapes in southern Tunisia.

For much of the year, this vast salt lake is almost completely dry. What remains is an immense white salt crust stretching toward the horizon, where heat and light often create mirages that make water seem to appear in the distance.

The road across Chott el Jerid is part of the journey between Tunisia’s oasis towns and the Sahara, and sunrise is one of the best times to see how dramatically the landscape changes with the light.

It is one of those places that photographs never quite explain until you stand there yourself.
